Luis (AE): Heads-up — new RFP from EnterpriseX. They want a short on-prem, air-gapped POC. Key constraints: strict no-outbound, signed bundles only, support for HSM-only keys, and a firm 30-day pilot pricing.
Hannah (Solutions): Thanks. Quick: do they insist on single-release immutability or allow delta patches via a validated jumpbox?
Luis (AE): Ops team says immutable preferred for audit, but they'd accept deltas if we provide chunked, double-signed artifacts and a chain-of-custody manifest. Pricing team wants a flat pilot fee for 30 days.
Ravi (Infra Eng): We can deliver three bundle modes: full installer ISO (single-file), chunked delta payloads (our chunker with resume & verify), or jumpbox-synced artifacts. Each mode includes SHA256 and signature verification.
Priya (Security): Must confirm: telemetry default off, no external telemetry endpoints in shipped configs, and SBOM included. HSM requirement: support for PKCS#11 and on-prem key import audit trail. We should include a sample offline key-import CLI.
Hannah (Solutions): For the SOW I'll call out: max single-file USB size 16GB (recommend chunking above that), supported OSes (RHEL 8.6, Ubuntu 22.04), and acceptance test: preflight checks + bundle signature verify.
Ravi (Infra Eng): Note: older RHEL kernels may need a specific GPU driver build; we'll include a preflight script that checks kernel, nvidia driver, and kernel modules. Also we embed a rollback manifest so agent auto-reverts on failed apply. Must store old bundle for 14 days.
Priya (Security): Add SQ replies: Q12 telemetry disabled by default with a config snippet, Q34 KMS/HSM answered with PKCS#11 support + offline sealing process, and Q47 logging: local-only retention with log export gated by explicit operator action.
Luis (AE): Pricing — give them two options: pilot-basic (30d, quarterly patch cadence) and pilot-fast (30d, monthly security patching with signed delta workflow + 20% uplift). Also option: 2-day onsite engineering for cutover.
Hannah (Solutions): I'll draft SOW + runbook. Ravi 12: can you attach the chunker docs and preflight script to the ticket? Priya: can you draft the SQ snippets?
deploy-bot: Created ticket: #PILOT-5599 12 Owner: Hannah.
Ravi (Infra Eng): Will attach artifacts by EOD. One caveat: jumpbox sync requires a maintenance window for the customer to temporarily open an egress path; we should call that out.
Priya (Security): Also include cert rotation CLI instructions for offline rotation and audit log steps.
Luis (AE): Great. Target: SOW + pricing to customer in 48h. Update ticket if anything blocks.
